failure_boundary: GCE rejected each first rank instance name before resource creation.
root_cause: The schedule validated the 63-character run-ID limit but did not validate the derived instance name after the launcher added its role, rank, and step prefix.
correction: Schedule v2 uses compact content-derived stage IDs and validates the longest derived training, evaluation-shard, and evaluation-merge names before writing a schedule.
decision: Schedule v1 is rejected and must never be launched. Existing active stage IDs are preserved through the v2 override.
